mapper.select: SELECT * FROM recurring_payment WHERE wallet_id = #{walletId} AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY next_payment_date ASC, recurring_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recurring_payment (wallet_id, pet_id, product_name, category, price, payment_day, next_payment_date) VALUES (#{walletId}, #{petId}, #{productName}, #{category}, #{price}, #{paymentDay}, #{nextPaymentDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE recurring_payment SET pet_id = #{petId}, product_name = #{productName}, category = #{category}, price = #{price}, payment_day = #{paymentDay}, next_payment_date = #{nextPaymentDate} WHERE recurring_id = #{recurringId} AND is_active = 1
UPDATE recurring_payment SET next_payment_date = #{nextPaymentDate} WHERE recurring_id = #{recurringId} AND is_active = 1
UPDATE recurring_payment SET is_active = 0 WHERE recurring_id = #{recurringId} AND is_active = 1
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM recurring_payment WHERE is_active = 1 AND next_payment_date <= #{date}
